description: This file defines React components and context hooks related to managing the toolbar state within a document editor in a React application. It includes context creation, a custom hook for accessing toolbar state, and a provider component that supplies combined context values for editor features, component blocks, and relationships.

classes.name: ToolbarStateContext
classes.description: React context for holding the toolbar state, allowing components to access or provide toolbar state within the React component tree.

methods.name: useToolbarState
methods.description: Custom React hook that provides access to the ToolbarState context, throwing an error if used outside of a ToolbarStateProvider.

methods.name: ToolbarStateProvider
methods.description: React component that sets up and provides the combined context values necessary for toolbar functionality, including component blocks, document features, and relationships, for its child components.
